select count(*) from UPDATE_PS_RETURN_MESSAGE where DOCUMENT_ID = #{DOCUMENT_ID, jdbcType=DECIMAL} and NVL(DATE_OF_DEATH, '01-Jan-1900') = NVL(#{DATE_OF_DEATH, jdbcType=DATE}, '01-Jan-1900') and NVL(LATEST_DISPOSITION_CODE, '999') = NVL(#{LATEST_DISPOSITION_CODE, jdbcType=INTEGER}, '999') and NVL(FIELDNOTES, 'XX') = NVL(#{FIELDNOTES, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'XX')
mapper.insert: insert into ${TABLE_NAME}(DOCUMENT_ID, DATE_OF_DEATH, LATEST_DISPOSITION_CODE, FIELDNOTES, CREATE_UID, CREATE_DATE) values(#{DOCUMENT_ID, jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{DATE_OF_DEATH, jdbcType=DATE}, #{LATEST_DISPOSITION_CODE, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{FIELDNOTES, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{CREATE_UID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: WITH stateno_in_clust AS ( SELECT nucl.cluster_id, nucl.cluster_type, pdoc.stateno curr_stateno, pdoc.document_id, scdoc.nyehms_stateno_at_upload org_stateno, nucl.cluster_identify_date clusterDate FROM person_doc_association pdoc, std_cluster_doc scdoc, nyehms_upload_cluster nucl WHERE pdoc.stateno = #{stateNo} AND pdoc.dissassociation_date IS NULL AND pdoc.document_id = scdoc.document_id AND scdoc.cluster_id_pk = nucl.cluster_id_pk ), stateno_not_in_clust AS ( SELECT ucl.cluster_id, ucl.cluster_type, ucl.cluster_identify_date clusterDate FROM nyehms_upload_cluster ucl, nyehms_upload_cluster_files uclf WHERE ucl.cluster_id_pk = uclf.cluster_id_pk AND ucl.cluster_type != 'BHAE_TS' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stateno_in_clust a WHERE a.cluster_id = ucl.cluster_id) ) SELECT Distinct curr_stateno, cluster_id clusterId, cluster_type clusterType, clusterDate FROM stateno_in_clust UNION SELECT Distinct NULL curr_stateno, cluster_id clusterId, cluster_type clusterType, clusterDate FROM stateno_not_in_clust
mapper.update: update NYEHMS_STD_MESSAGE_SENT set PROCESS_IND = 'R_X', REVIEW_COMMENTS = 'Triggering Document Deleted', REVIEW_UID = #{p_workerId}, REVIEW_DATE = sysdate where FOLLOW_UP_DOC_ID = #{p_document_id} and process_ind = 'R'

update NYEHMS_RIA_DOC set STATENO_DELETED = 'Y', COMMENTS = 'Triggering Document Deleted', LAST_UPDATED_BY = #{p_workerId}, LAST_UPDATED_DATE = sysdate where LAB_DOC_ID = #{p_document_id} and COMPLETE_DATE is null
